title: Bram and the Garden
author: Emrys Vane
blurb: Casper Lockridge, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
